input.prompt: One continuous five-second editorial bakery product shot. A single freshly baked golden croissant with irregular crisp laminated layers rests on ivory parchment on a round matte cream plate, on a dark walnut bakery counter. The croissant and plate sit in the right half of the image, warm cream tiled background, empty walnut counter at left. Soft morning window light from upper left, physically coherent crumbs and soft shadows, warm neutral white balance. The camera moves slowly straight forward a few centimeters, then eases to a full stop by four seconds and holds the exact final composition. The croissant and plate never move. Real baked pastry texture, understated food photography. No steam, no hands, no extra pastries, no morphing, no lettering, no logos, no cuts.
